author: Jonas Weber
text: The Meridian VoiceConnect trunk: outbound is fine, inbound never arrives. No error anywhere. Trunk looks half alive.

author: Omid Mohajerani
text: What's in the IP Access Control List?

author: Jonas Weber
text: The AudioCodes hostname - qqjjgaaaqdcr.sip1-region1.audiocodes.io. It resolves to the right IP, I checked.

author: Omid Mohajerani
text: That's it. The VC ACL does not resolve host names, it compares the literal value. A resolving implementation would have matched, so we know it doesn't. Put 198.51.100.15/32 in there.

author: Jonas Weber
text: Inbound working. That would have taken me another day.

author: Omid Mohajerani
text: Whitelist the media address too - 198.51.100.49. Signalling and media are different hosts and people miss the second one.
